text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after first hearing the rumors
about Tosen Jordan, I
happen to see her
as I pass by the school gates.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are, Jordan! The teacher's
looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know. The school just hit me up.
I'm headed over now.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Well, you better hurry! She seemed really angry... You can't skip class and practice. You might get kicked out, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I know.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Skipping class, not even showing up for
tests... All that could be
overlooked if you
were entering races, but you won't even
train.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
What's going on here, Jordan? I know you
were injured, but you never
let that affect
you before... If you need someone to talk
to, you know
I'm here for you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I dunno. I'm just, like... low-key in a slump,
I guess?

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Please take this seriously... I'm worried
about you. Is it an issue of
motivation?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I. Don't. Know. Period. End of story.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Sigh... All right. Let's call this meeting adjourned. For now, I've made a worksheet summarizing this week's lessons. Once you finish, you may go.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
When you feel like racing again, you know
where to find me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real though, what was I supposed to
say? Even I don't know what the
problem
is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several hours after seeing her at the gates,
I'm walking down the
academy corridors
when I notice Tosen Jordan sitting in an
empty
room, struggling with a worksheet.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Solve with a natural number, assuming the square root is also a natural number." What's that mean? Like, numbers in nature? What does that mean? Trees?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! This is straight up code! How am I
supposed to know what to
do? This
suuuucks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She slams her head dramatically into the
desk. As she does, the
worksheet in her
hands gets caught on something, causing it
to rip.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Great. Just... great. I am... so done.
Deceased.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
How's the homework coming along—huh?
Did you... rip up your
worksheet?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, well... I guess I did.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Well... you've made yourself clear. I see
you have no intention of
improving
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
But you MUST learn to use your words! I
can't believe you would rip
up your
worksheet just to prove a point!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From what I saw, the worksheet ripping
was just an unfortunate
accident. Of
course, if she just explains what happened,
I'm sure the
teacher will understand.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whatever...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: I'm trying to help you, you know. But if you don't work with me, I can't do anything.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Have you really lost your drive? You really
want to stop racing? Truly?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I don't know. How am I supposed to know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But if that's how everyone sees it, then it
doesn't sound that outta
pocket to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Instead of clearing her name, she simply
turns her back on the teacher
and walks
away. It's like she's given up... I decide to
follow to make
sure she's okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I finally catch up to her, I find her
carefully coating her injured
toenail with
strengthener. Other nail care products are
laid out
around her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Stupid toenail. Stupid medical care. Stupid Tickezo, always crying whenever I treat it in our room, making me do it outside. It's all so... stupid.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If it weren't for my stupid flimsy toe,
maybe I—ugh. Forget it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She sounds exhausted, but from her
careful application, it's clear
she's treating
her injury as best she can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't imagine someone who takes such
good care of themselves
would want to
stop racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So why is she refusing to race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get my chance a few days later, when I
spot Tosen Jordan skipping
class and
wandering aimlessly around town.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's an academy trainer want with
me?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Talk? Ah... Did the school put you up to
this? I'm sure having a
student skipping
classes and training is a big yikes for
admin.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but I've, like, lost my motivation or
whatever. Don't waste your
time on me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What?! Wait, when?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I quickly apologize for not saying anything
at the time, but explain
that I've wanted to
speak with her since then.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Because I was taking care of my
toenail? You've got it all wrong.
I just feel
weird if I don't treat it regularly.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You can't tell if I wanna run just from that. I mean, even I don't know what my deal is.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And, like, why's it any of your business,
anyway? I'm not exactly
radiating main
character energy over here, so what's the
point?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Growl...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I-ignore that! I just skipped breakfast,
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Now you're trying to bribe me with food?! I have some dignity, you know!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hm... Okay, bet. But only if we go to that place and only if you'll let me eat as much as I want.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the place Jordan pointed out, I
find myself staring at a
flashy fast food
restaurant.
